title: Square pin fin with convective faces (3D, analytic)
description:
3D steady conduction in an aluminium pin fin of square cross-section W x W and length L: the base face x_lo held at T_base, the four long faces (y_lo, y_hi, z_lo, z_hi) cooled by convection h toward T_inf (Robin on outer faces, incl. the z faces), the tip x_hi insulated; 160 x 9 x 9 cells.
Analytic (fin equation with the first transverse eigenvalue): theta = theta_b cosh(m (L - x)) / cosh(m L), m^2 = 4 h / (k W) (1 - Bi / 3), Bi = h (W / 2) / k (~1e-3: the cross-section is nearly isothermal); efficiency tanh(m L) / (m L), tip ratio 1 / cosh(m L).
Derived values tab: efficiency (volume mean of T_rise / theta_b), tip_ratio and mid_ratio (probes on the axis at x = L - dx / 2 and x = L / 2 + dx / 2). Expect ~1e-3 or better (transverse profile O(Bi), face Robin in series with the half cell).
Line profile tab (mid-height cut z = W / 2): T_rise_axis along x through the axis.

parameters.name: T_inf
parameters.description: ambient temperature in K (also the heat T0)

parameters.name: k_al
parameters.description: aluminium thermal conductivity in W/(m K)

parameters.name: h_conv
parameters.description: heat transfer coefficient of the four long faces in W/(m^2 K) (forced air)

parameters.name: W_fin
parameters.description: cross-section side (odd cell count: the axis is a cell centre)

parameters.name: Bi_half
parameters.description: Biot number on the half width (~9.5e-4)

parameters.name: x_tip
parameters.description: x of the tip probe (centre of the last cell)

parameters.name: x_mid
parameters.description: x of the mid probe (a cell centre)
